title: Board Game Night
description:
Like board games? Come play with us. We'll have tables, chairs, and a stack of games ready to go -- play one of ours or bring your own. The more the merrier. (18+ unless accompanied by an adult)

Board Game Night is free and open to the public. Come solo or bring friends, meet new people and share good times. Grab a seat, and jump into whatever's on the table. No experience needed, just good vibes.

**Details:**

-   Free event, open to the public.
-   Games, tables, and chairs provided — welcome to bring your own
-   Bring your own snacks and non-alcoholic drinks. (Candy, snacks, and drinks also available for a small donation)
-   First time at the Makerspace? Ask for a tour

**Finding us:** We're in the back of Palm Tree Plaza, with plenty of free parking.  
See you at the there!
